name: @mgread-plugin/fanqie-novel
description: MgRead native novel source for Fanqie.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/contract.test.mjs test/source.test.mjs
scripts.pack:plugin: npm run build && node tools/mgread.mjs pack

mgread.description: 番茄小说是网络小说阅读平台，分类页汇集不同题材的小说作品。可搜索书名、查看作品介绍和章节目录，并打开小说正文。
